title: OUR BOUTIQUE
subtitle: A Private Haven in Glasgow City Centre
intro: The Bridal Courtyard is designed as an intimate single-appointment boutique where you receive 100% of our attention.
paragraphs: Located at 152 West Regent Street, our boutique offers a calm, welcoming environment away from the bustle of the high street.
During your private appointment, the boutique is closed strictly to everyone except you and your guests. Enjoy complimentary drinks, relax, and explore our collection at your own pace.
